title: The Extra Stop

cards.text: My car's GPS keeps adding a stop I never typed in.
I'm driving alone, but the screen says, "Passenger requested."
I deleted it, and the car filled with the smell of wet leaves.
Ten minutes later, the stop was back, and much closer.
Then the seatbelt warning for the back seat started blinking.
I drove to the dirt road it wanted, just to make it stop.
The back door opened, then quietly shut, and the warning went dark.
The GPS said, "Both passengers buckled. Heading home."

outro: Follow for a new story every night.
